commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a freed thief working for Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. The Unbound, a tribeless cult led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain Hist sap, seal scars with grey paste, and send jars to him for a draught tied to the Eye. 2. Go to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom and speak to her; Cheeval-Xu can point the way. 3. Ask Cheeval-Xu for directions, or go straight through the door to Nesh-Deeka House. Boatmen Lodge is another door. 4. I do not understand what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is, or who Nesh-Deeka is. I could find out by asking people and Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. Nesh-Deeka, the handler, heard my report. The Eye is the Eye of Argonia, the priest-kings Hist amber jewel at the Root under the sea behind a sealed gate. Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants it, and the sap draught is probably to kill whatever guards it. She wants proof of me. 2. Get the jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa at the Boatmens Lodge in Helstrom and bring it to Nesh-Deeka. 3. Pickpocket the jar from his pack, buy it for 100 gold (I have about 150), or fight Keel-Raa and his two hired men; the levy will not count that as a crime. I favour pickpocket. 4. I do not know where the Root gate is, what the seal paste is made of, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is. Keel-Raa might tell me something if I talk to him.

answer 1. I lifted the jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa, as proof for Nesh-Deeka. 2. Bring the jar to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom. 3. Just deliver it; I could also leave it, but that would not help. 4. Still unknown: where the Root gate is, what the seal is made of, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is.

answer 1. Quest done: I gave Nesh-Deeka the jar and became a Voh-Vastei, apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka, with armour and 200 gold. The order wants to find the Root before the Unbound and use the Eye to heal the trees. 2. Ride the rootworm from Helstrom city tree (Cheeval-Xu calls it) to Gideon and find the Eye of Argonia for sale in the market, learning where it came from. 3. Go to Gideon, or first ask Nesh-Deeka about the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, the order ranks and history, and trade with order traders. 4. I do not know what the Xeech-Leel or Umbriel are, nor whether the Gideon eye is glass; I can ask Nesh-Deeka the topics listed.

answer Tarin, thief, now Voh-Vastei (apprentice) of the Toh-Reel-Ka. I met Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, pickpocketed Keel-Raa jar of sap at the Boatmens Lodge and gave it to her. I have the Voh-Vastei armour, about 350 gold, lockpick, Hist blessing and the Unbound note. Known: the Eye of Argonia is the priest-kings Hist amber jewel at the Root under the sea behind a gate sealed by the last king; Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants it and probably means to kill whatever guards it. The order wants it found first to heal the trees. Next lead: an Eye for sale in Gideon market (west); most are glass, find where it came from. Cheeval-Xu at the Helstrom city tree calls the rootworm there. Unknown: seal paste, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel (can ask Nesh-Deeka).
